title: Explicit empty periods
instructions: Return exactly twelve DATE months in 2024 and count paid orders in each UTC month. Empty months have count zero.

A paid order is an order whose own status is 'paid'; the payments table carries a separate status that these challenges never ask about. For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving explicit empty periods.

hints.text: A generated calendar preserves periods with no activity.
Left join qualifying orders to the calendar and count matched identities.
March has no paid orders; COUNT(*) would turn its outer row into one.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT count(*)::VARCHAR FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-03-01 00:00:00+00' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-04-01 00:00:00+00'
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: March has no paid orders
